notes: Recurrence-assessment core of the %hdcov macro (hdPS Steps 2 & 3): rank a claims dimension by prevalence, derive median/Q3/P90 count cutpoints, assign the ordinal covariate and cov_once/cov_sporadic/cov_frequent flags. Original reads Medicare claims from external SAS libraries; here the same logic runs against a synthetic dx3 inpatient dimension + cohort built inline. Macro renamed to hdcov_recur and stopped before the final wide-transpose step so it runs with no external deps.
